changes.title: Friendly wave
items: An area whose legend's quest you've done no longer turns on you when its wave comes: its animals stay friendly, so the night can always be won

changes.title: Bots pace
items: The bot game's witch plays today's game again: she invites ahead of the waves, answers sieges, feeds her babies berries till they're youths, and sees off the last enraged animals to win the night

changes.title: Recorded singer
items: The music's singer is now a real recorded voice singing "laa" and "loo", drifting through a long, shimmering reverb
